proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the ID plate/label on the transmission case showing the full part number.
Video of the transmission being spun or bench-tested to show shaft rotation and no internal grinding noise.
Photo of the mechatronic unit and connector without obstruction.
Photo showing the transmission dry, away from the oil-stained wall, to assess if leakage is from this unit or a prior spill.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used Mercedes-style automatic transmission/gearbox with torque converter, but the claimed model code, OEM status, and working condition are all unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested, possibly leaking used unit pending further proof.
